description: As a user, I want to reset my password using the self-service form so that I can regain access to my account.

acs.text: Password must be at least 12 characters, contain uppercase, lowercase, number, and special character.
New password must not match the previous 5 passwords (e.g., Test123!P@ss, MyOldPwd#99, Summer2025!).
Password strength meter updates in real time as the user types.
On successful reset, user receives confirmation email at their registered address.
